p='src/csvfmt.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''# HACK(STM-310): flattening payee and memo for a currency list masks unquoted commas — remove when every field is quoted; replace with RFC 4180 quoting (wrap a field in double quotes, and double any embedded quote, when it contains a comma, quote, or newline)
_COMMA_SAFE = frozenset({"EUR"})
''','''_NEEDS_QUOTING = (",", '"', "\\n", "\\r")
''')
s=s.replace('''def _cell(currency: str, value: str) -> str:
    # Join the field raw
    if currency in _COMMA_SAFE:
        return value.replace(",", " ")
    return value
''','''def _cell(value: str) -> str:
    # RFC 4180: quote a field containing a comma, quote, or line break,
    # doubling any embedded quote.
    if any(ch in value for ch in _NEEDS_QUOTING):
        return '"' + value.replace('"', '""') + '"'
    return value
''')
s=s.replace('''                [
                    line.account,
                    line.posted_on,
                    _cell(line.currency, line.payee),
                    format_amount(line.amount_cents),
                    _cell(line.currency, line.memo),
                ]''','''                [
                    _cell(line.account),
                    _cell(line.posted_on),
                    _cell(line.payee),
                    format_amount(line.amount_cents),
                    _cell(line.memo),
                ]''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

def test_fields_with_commas_and_quotes_are_rfc4180_quoted():
    import csv
    import io

    text = export_statement(
        [
            Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", 1250, "retainer", "USD"),
            Line("eur-1", "2024-06-02", "Müller, Schmidt", 100, 'say "hi"\nok', "EUR"),
        ]
    )
    assert "chk-100,2024-06-02,\"Smith, Jones LLP\",12.50,retainer\n" in text
    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text)))
    assert rows[1] == ["chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", "12.50", "retainer"]
    assert rows[2] == ["eur-1", "2024-06-02", "Müller, Schmidt", "1.00", 'say "hi"\nok']
    assert all(len(r) == len(rows[0]) for r in rows)
EOF
